details:
Since the update a lot of things have been requested and a lot of prototypes look impressing already, here are a few things I would like to have with them, mainly for comfort or habit

Field of view slider/adjust

a way to increase the desktop field of view, either through slider or keyboard input, mainly due to being used to play other games with higher field of view (ranging to 120-150 for my experience) the standard one currently feels very zoomed in and makes me uncomfortable at times
Ability to view recent usernames

I know this one could be conflictable with people trying to escape a situation, though it also would be useful to regain memory of someone or get context to a person again who has not been around for a bit
Indication on instances you have visited before
I had the issue of running into the same public instance more than once after it dying out slowly and rejoining that instance again only to find it empty again (also a way to refresh the listing of public instances would assist this)

Customization of GUI elements

I do not disagree with the given colors, yet I would like to adjust it to my comfort, what I mean specifically is the menu coloring as well as have the ability to recolor the voice indicator, if I am not already asking for too much, nameplate coloring (user, friend, favorite friend group/s)

Post processing adjustment

this would be an immense help in some worlds with bloom for example, as shaders give some avatars/objects very intense brightness/glow, which is an eye strain for the human eye

Cache clearing
an automation of this process on either start up or quit, with the option to allow it at all, mainly due to being forgetful of it at times and the extra restart is sometimes a bother

these are my extra wishes amongst the other hundreds of requests currently and I hope someone besides me wishes for these as well
title: Field of view, Customization and Comfort features
